name: internalRequest
syntax: internalRequest(template [, method] [, urls] [, forms] [, cookies] [, headers] [, body] [, charset] [, addToken] [, throwonerror])
description: Runs a request for a template inside the current Lucee server, without going over HTTP, and returns a struct with the response.

params.name: template
params.description: The template path to request, such as `/test/index.cfm`.

params.name: method
params.description: The HTTP method, such as `GET` or `POST`.

params.name: urls
params.description: URL variables, as a struct or a `name=value&name2=value2` string.

params.name: forms
params.description: Form variables, as a struct or a `name=value&name2=value2` string.

params.name: charset
params.description: The charset of the request. Defaults to the web charset.

params.name: addToken
params.description: When true, adds the session token as a cookie.

params.name: throwonerror
params.description: When true, an exception in the requested template is rethrown. When false, it is only reported in the result.
